reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the CCGA substudy 1 batch (Jamshidi et al. 2022) for use-case-plasma-ctdna-methylation and use-case-plasma-ctdna-fragmentomics: 79 records (22 results, 22 evaluations, 10 configurations, 10 methods, 8 claims including 5 relevance judgements, 3 datasets, 3 protocols, 1 source). Every Table 3 cell and every cancer signal origin value checked against the PDF text layer; every percentage recomputed from TP/total and every 95% interval recomputed as Clopper-Pearson. See docs/reviews/use-cases/plasma-ctdna-jamshidi-2026-10-10.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any classifier.
The source PDF is not archived (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0); its hash and figshare MD5 pin the bytes read.
The supplement (Tables S1 and S2, Figures S1 to S8) was not read in this review.

The collector's Unpaywall call sent an email parameter; this has since been reported to the owner, and no file in the batch records the address. This review made no such call and sent no personal identifier.

Relevance judgement pins are left unset for the integrator; all judgements and both summaries on the two use cases were simulated active after re-pinning, with the approved use-case and summary text applied in memory.

errors.message: The 833/464 against 854/485 gap is explained by the source: detection was restricted to solid cancers, and Table 1 lists 21 plasma cell neoplasms and leukaemias in each set. The 'not explained' limitation was replaced.

Classifiers developed after validation unblinding (fragment endpoints, fragment lengths, allelic imbalance, pan-feature) excluded from the methylation detection judgements with reasons; only the six double-blinded classifiers are reviewed.
Regraded from direct to proxy: internal cross-validation in the design set, with the independent validation giving the direct estimate for the same locked classifiers.
Pan-feature classifier excluded (combines all nine cfDNA scores, not a fragmentomics workflow, developed after unblinding); fragment rows labelled as not a blinded validation.

record_ids: seven validation results with Table 3 marks b or c
errors.message: Footnote letters moved out of printed_value into printed_source_cell; claims.csv synced.

Approved use-case text changes pinned fields and the summaries change: all eight existing methylation judgements and all eleven existing fragmentomics judgements hold, and must be re-pinned with the new judgements and both updated summaries.
